annotations.annotation_text: Ninsei, the neon-lit entertainment strip of Night City, is mapped by Gibson with hardboiled noir topography overlaid with Japanese commercial signage and clandestine bio-clinics.
sources: Tatsumi, Takayuki. Full Metal Apache. Duke UP, 2006.

annotations.annotation_text: The illicit chemical economy of Chiba, where neurohormones and designer neurotransmitters are trafficked as high-margin commodities beyond zaibatsu customs.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 12.
